import MumfordLib.SimplicialCochainGluing
import MumfordLib.SingularSmallChains
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyContractible

/-!
# Local primitives for singular small cochains

The singular set of a subspace identifies with its image subcomplex. Transport
along this isomorphism turns local singular primitives into simplicial ones.
The two-subcomplex gluing theorem then constructs primitives on small chains.

This supplies the local-to-small-chain step for the circle computation in
Mumford, Chapter I, Section 1, p. 3. The comparison with all singular chains of
an open cover remains a separate subdivision theorem.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Existence of primitives transports along an isomorphism of simplicial sets. -/
theorem simplicialCochain_exists_primitive_of_iso {K L : SSet} (e : K ≅ L) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K (n + 1),
      simplicialCochainDifferential K (n + 1) φ = 0 →
      ∃ ψ, simplicialCochainDifferential K n ψ = φ)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain L (n + 1))
    (hφ : simplicialCochainDifferential L (n + 1) φ = 0) :
    ∃ ψ, simplicialCochainDifferential L n ψ = φ := by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := h (simplicialCochainPullback e.hom (n + 1) φ) (by
    rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hφ, map_zero])
  refine ⟨simplicialCochainPullback e.inv n ψ, ?_⟩
  rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hψ,
    ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, e.inv_hom_id]
  simp [simplicialCochainPullback]

/-- Local singular cocycle primitives give primitives on the subset subcomplex. -/
theorem singularSubset_exists_primitive (X : TopCat) (U : Set X) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ φ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of U) (n + 1),
      ∃ ψ, singularCoboundaryToCocycles (TopCat.of U) n ψ = φ)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (singularSubset X U) (n + 1))
    (hφ : simplicialCochainDifferential (singularSubset X U) (n + 1) φ = 0) :
    ∃ ψ, simplicialCochainDifferential (singularSubset X U) n ψ = φ := by
  apply simplicialCochain_exists_primitive_of_iso (singularSubsetIso X U) n _ φ hφ
  intro α hα
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := h ⟨α, hα⟩
  exact ⟨β, congrArg Subtype.val hβ⟩

/-- Two local singular primitive computations and the overlap computation produce
primitives on the singular simplices lying in either subset. -/
theorem smallSingularCochain_two_exists_primitive (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (n : ℕ)
    (hU : ∀ φ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of U) (n + 2),
      ∃ ψ, singularCoboundaryToCocycles (TopCat.of U) (n + 1) ψ = φ)
    (hV : ∀ φ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of V) (n + 2),
      ∃ ψ, singularCoboundaryToCocycles (TopCat.of V) (n + 1) ψ = φ)
    (hUV : ∀ φ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) (n + 1),
      ∃ ψ, singularCoboundaryToCocycles (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) n ψ = φ)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V :
      (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex) (n + 2))
    (hφ : simplicialCochainDifferential _ (n + 2) φ = 0) :
    ∃ ψ, simplicialCochainDifferential _ (n + 1) ψ = φ := by
  apply simplicialCochain_union_exists_primitive (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V)
    n (singularSubset_exists_primitive X U (n + 1) hU)
    (singularSubset_exists_primitive X V (n + 1) hV) _ φ hφ
  intro α hα
  exact simplicialCochain_exists_primitive_of_iso
    (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)) n
    (singularSubset_exists_primitive X (U ∩ V) n hUV) α hα

/-- Contractible subsets and a contractible intersection have acyclic small
cochains in degrees at least two. -/
theorem smallSingularCochain_two_exists_primitive_of_contractible
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) [ContractibleSpace U] [ContractibleSpace V]
    [ContractibleSpace (U ∩ V : Set X)] (n : ℕ)
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V :
      (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex) (n + 2))
    (hφ : simplicialCochainDifferential _ (n + 2) φ = 0) :
    ∃ ψ, simplicialCochainDifferential _ (n + 1) ψ = φ :=
  smallSingularCochain_two_exists_primitive X U V n
    singularCocycle_exists_primitive_of_contractible
    singularCocycle_exists_primitive_of_contractible
    singularCocycle_exists_primitive_of_contractible φ hφ

end Mumford.Analytic
